onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.intro: Choose how to begin. You can switch paths later, nothing here is locked in.

pathChoice.freshBody: Set up your own books step by step: company, fiscal year, VAT, and your creditor profile.
pathChoice.importBody: Bring your existing books across with the data migration: export files in, a dry run, a tie-out check, then go live.
pathChoice.importNeedsWorkspace: An import needs the workspace shell first: create it in Setup, then the data migration takes over.
pathChoice.demoBody: Explore TILL with sample Swiss books: real contacts, items and issued invoices, disposable at any time.

err.generic: That did not work. Try again, or start fresh instead.

banner.title: You are exploring a demo workspace
banner.confirmDiscard: Delete the demo workspace and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
banner.needsManageSettings: You need the manage settings right to discard a demo.

Onboarding.title: Getting started
Onboarding.body: Three paths into your books: start fresh, take over from an existing system, or look at a demo first. Every path leads onto the product's ordinary surfaces; this entry point only remembers where you stand and decides nothing for you. You can leave it at any time and continue later.
